propositions: Hosted OpenAI (bare openai:/gpt-*/o1/o3/chatgpt with no custom endpoint) must default-resolve to openai-responses: under pydantic-ai 1.107.2
Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints (top-level base_url, per-slot endpoint, or per-candidate endpoint) must resolve to openai-chat: with no Responses alternative
An explicit openai-chat: qualifier or provider=openai-chat fallback must exist, emit a once-per-run deprecation notice pointing to openai-responses:, and be scheduled for removal in v1.0.0

Provider resolution across four constraint sites (config.py KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES, providers.py _pydantic_ai_known_providers, capabilities.py _PROFILE_RESOLVERS, model_classes.py _resolve_target) must thread endpoint information to preserve identity-matching consistency
The deprecation notice must fire only for hosted openai-chat: (no base_url) and must NOT fire for endpoint-forced chat (construction constraint)
Contract tests over both openai-responses: and openai-chat: prefixes must validate structured output, streaming, tool calls, retries, and custom base URL behaviors
